questions.original: No horno pa bollos, no horno pa bollos hoy
questions.issue: 'No horno pa bollos' = 'no está el horno para bollos' (it's not the time/mood); 'bollo' also = dyke, double meaning that cannot be kept in en/eu. Chose 'not hot for buns' (keeps bun + sexual sense); alternative 'no time for dykes today'.

questions.original: papi ven que te como el morro.
questions.issue: 'comer el morro' = to snog / kiss hard (morro also = lips/snout); rendered as snogging.

questions.original: Me se sale el huevo de la falda
questions.issue: 'huevo' = ball/testicle; in eu 'arrautza' (egg) used jokingly, check preferred slang for balls. 'Me se sale' is deliberately ungrammatical colloquial Spanish, not reproduced.

questions.original: Es que ni con medias me sagarra
questions.issue: 'me sagarra' is a typo/phonetic spelling of 'me se agarra' (block 7 spells it correctly).

questions.original: Que estoy to guapa to flaman
questions.issue: 'to flaman' unclear: maybe 'flamante' (brand new/stunning) or 'flamenco/flaming'. Rendered as 'flamin''.

questions.original: no ves que tengo todo el pica pica?
questions.issue: 'pica pica' = finger food/nibbles and also itching/stinging; both senses forced into en/eu. 'Xica' is Catalan/Galician-style spelling of 'chica'.

questions.original: Me puedo multiplicar contigo o no?
questions.issue: 'multiplicarse contigo' - unclear whether a math/gender-binary joke (one+one) or sexual/reproductive; translated literally.

questions.original: Congratulations it's a boy, you must be so proud, SO PROUD!
questions.issue: es/eu translation addresses the parents in inclusive plural ('orgulloses'); original 'you must be so proud' is gender-neutral.
